O Oyshi Bangla Bistro

Find your Firebase keys

Project: oyshi-bangla-bistro

Do NOT use these (wrong place)

  • Service account (firebase-adminsdk@...) — server only, not for website
  • Web Push certificates — notifications only
  • Project ID / Project number — you have these, but not enough alone

You need: Web app → apiKey and appId

Open Firebase settings (click here)

First time? Add a Web app

If you do not see “SDK setup” or “firebaseConfig”:

  1. On Firebase home, find the title oyshi-bangla-bistro
  2. Under it, click the Web icon </> (not Android or Apple)
  3. Nickname: Oyshi Website → Register app
  4. On “Add Firebase SDK” screen — copy the config shown (or click Continue)

Where the keys are

  1. Click the gear icon next to “Project Overview” (top left)
  2. Click Project settings
  3. Stay on the General tab
  4. Scroll down to Your apps
  5. Click your web app </> Oyshi Website (or add one first — see above)
  6. Under SDK setup and configuration, choose Config
  7. Copy the block that starts with apiKey:

What to copy (send in chat or put in js/config.js)

apiKey: "......"
authDomain: "oyshi-bangla-bistro.firebaseapp.com"
projectId: "oyshi-bangla-bistro"
storageBucket: "......"
messagingSenderId: "533772481391"
appId: "1:533772481391:web:......"
